title: Transform-Based Multilinear Algebra via Tensor Decomposition
summary: Transform-based tensor products, including the T-product and its more general form, namely the higher-order tensor-tensor product, have become fundamental tools for multilinear data analysis in applications such as image processing, signal reconstruction, and robotics. While invertible transforms enable tensor computations to be carried out via matrix operations in the transform domain, the resulting storage and computational costs remain prohibitive for high-dimensional, higher-order tensors.
